music.name: GG Magree at Code Red
music.why: Code Red is retooling its whole format for this one, swapping the usual club night for a five-act warehouse production built around an Australian hard-dance vocalist.
music.summary: Australian DJ/producer GG Magree headlines a reimagined Code Red concept night at the 1720 Warehouse in Downtown LA, with five local support acts.

music.name: DANSE-X: Gina Kuhn Birthday
music.why: No-cover goth/new-wave night with a dedicated vinyl-only front room and a birthday-set headliner, a rare free door for this scene.
music.summary: DANSE-X returns to Monty Bar for Gina Kuhn's birthday with a vinyl-only new wave/darkwave/goth/Italo front room and a classics-and-rarities back room, Saturday 9pm, no cover, 21+.

music.name: Clinic x Big Terry Time feat. Thee Mike B
music.address: 1640 N Cahuenga Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028
music.why: Cheap $5 early-entry midweek house night with an outdoor vendor market attached
music.summary: Clinic x Big Terry Time brings a Wednesday house night to Jungle Hollywood with support from Toxic Kitty, Rachel Lee, Triple Aye and Boss Fairy, plus an outdoor vendor market.

music.name: Nightshift After Hours
music.why: Alley-entry DTLA speakeasy running past sunrise with a secret rotating house DJ lineup
music.summary: Nightshift turns The Lexington into a DTLA speakeasy after-hours spot for underground house music, open until 5am with a secret DJ lineup curated by the Blind Tiger collective.

music.name: RÜFÜS DU SOL, Ben Böhmer
music.why: A-list global headliner arena show — the biggest ticket in LA this week
music.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL bring their North America 2026 tour to the Kia Forum with support from Ben Böhmer, playing their atmospheric blend of dance and indie rock for a full arena crowd.

music.name: Mixmag LAB: LA ft What So Not
music.why: Marquee touring producer in Mixmag's own LA lab series — bigger production than a normal club night
music.summary: Mixmag LAB Los Angeles brings Australian producer What So Not to 1720 for a night of future bass, trap and house blended with cinematic sound design, with support from clubaction.

music.name: Just Like That with DJ Adam Lucky (Numero Group)
music.address: 1746 N Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
music.why: Free vinyl-only disco/house set to open the weekend early, no cover
music.summary: DJ Adam Lucky of the Numero Group record label spins dance-friendly disco and house, all on vinyl, to kick off the weekend early at Apotheke.

music.name: Obscene (Goth / Industrial / EBM) w guest Matt Hart (UK) & LA Industrial Battle of the Bands
music.why: A live battle-of-the-bands format rare in the goth/industrial scene, plus a UK touring guest
music.summary: Monthly dark-music night in DTLA with residents Industria Nova and Damascus Knives, featuring UK musician/DJ Matt Hart and a live LA Industrial Battle of the Bands.

music.name: Nightshift After Hours
music.why: A speakeasy after-hours that runs till 5am — for the crowd not ready to go home
music.summary: Nightshift's weekly speakeasy after-hours at The Lexington in DTLA runs deep into the morning with a secret DJ lineup curated by the Blind Tiger artist collective, entered through the alley.

music.name: Beatport Live x HARD Selects Takeover: DJ Seinfeld, salute, Chloëdees
music.address: 909 S Santa Fe Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90021
music.why: A free HARD Summer cooldown set at Beatport's own LA headquarters, RSVP only
music.summary: Beatport Live links with HARD Selects for a Los Angeles takeover the week after HARD Summer, with DJ Seinfeld, salute and Chloëdees playing at Beatport's LA HQ.

music.name: Bu Tea Call Fridays
music.address: 2715 S Main St, Los Angeles, CA 90007
music.why: A tea-house doubling as a house/tech-house dance floor - an unusual, low-key weekly spot
music.summary: Weekly Friday house and tech-house night at Bu Tea Den, a South LA tea house venue.

music.name: RÜFÜS DU SOL with Ben Böhmer
music.why: A-list touring headliner in an arena setting - the marquee pick of the night
music.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL bring their North America 2026 tour to the Kia Forum with support from Ben Böhmer, doors 6:30pm ahead of a 7:30pm start.

music.name: Anemone x VPN Radio
music.why: Free underground electro/dub-techno night with a rotating radio-show lineup
music.summary: Anemone teams with VPN Radio for a free night of electro, techno, house and dub techno at The Airliner, featuring Eva Myra May, Naomi Green, Max Ellington and Saish K.

music.name: Büff Long Beach: Cazwell
music.address: 2020 E Artesia Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90805
music.why: Circuit-house LGBTQ+ night headlined by a well-known queer nightlife DJ
music.summary: Hump Events' Büff Long Beach party at Falcon North brings circuit house, tech house and big-room house with headliner Cazwell.

music.name: Resistance 001: Iku, Luciden, Notdeadyet, Moros b2b Nyxzara, Kensuke, Bakhu, Keenky
music.why: A stacked seven-act bass/hard-dance bill for a deep dive into the DIY rave scene
music.summary: DIY Raves x Bear Cave Events launch Resistance 001 at Matriarch LA with a seven-act trap, dubstep, bass and hard-dance lineup.

music.name: Yet More
music.why: House/tech-house night on a 17th-floor penthouse rooftop with 360-degree city views
music.summary: We Are Definition present Yet More, a house and tech-house night on Pluto's rooftop penthouse overlooking the LA skyline.

music.name: Flashback: A 2010s EDM Tribute Party
music.address: 618 S Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90014
music.why: A nostalgia-driven big-room/electro-house throwback night for 2010s EDM fans
music.summary: Exchange LA turns back the clock with a 2010s EDM tribute night spanning big-room house, electro house and pop EDM anthems.

music.name: Oscar G
music.address: 1601 N Cahuenga Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028
music.why: A Miami house legend (Murk/Ultra Music Festival) headlining an intimate Hollywood room
music.summary: Miami house veteran Oscar G headlines a late night at The Spotlight in Hollywood.

music.name: Muzique Fridays
music.why: Free-with-RSVP weekly disco/house night for a low-cost Friday option
music.summary: Momentus LA's weekly Muzique Fridays night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang spins disco, house and nu-disco with special guest DJs, free with RSVP.

music.name: Paul van Dyk
music.why: A globally touring trance icon, worth the short trip down to Orange County
music.summary: Trance legend Paul van Dyk headlines Time Nightclub in Costa Mesa with progressive house support.

music.name: Chris Luno
music.address: 1642 N Las Palmas Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90028
music.why: Progressive/tech-house 'playa tech' set for the desert-festival crowd
music.summary: Chris Luno headlines Sound Nightclub in Hollywood with progressive house, tech house and playa tech.

music.name: Getter
music.why: A well-known touring bass/dubstep headliner in a mid-size Hollywood room
music.summary: Bass and dubstep artist Getter headlines a late Hollywood night at Academy Nightclub.

music.name: NIGHTSHIFT AFTER HOURS
music.why: Free-before-1am after-hours tech house/minimal for the true night owls
music.summary: Blind Tiger's Nightshift After Hours brings tech house and minimal to The Lexington in DTLA, free with RSVP before 1am.

music.name: Phantoms POOL PARTY at Level 8
music.address: 1254 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015
music.why: Chart-topping indie-house duo headlines a daytime rooftop pool party downtown
music.summary: Phantoms (Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola) headline Golden Hour at Level 8's rooftop pool party, with support from Stereo Punks and Orlove by Day.

music.name: La Defensa presents: Rhythm Oasis
music.why: Free daytime fundraiser mixing baile funk and Latin house for a good cause
music.summary: La Defensa hosts an afternoon of baile funk, reggaeton, global bass and Latin house with DJ Izla, DJ Chana and DJ Busa, with raffle prizes benefiting the organization's justice work.

music.name: EMBRZ at Harbor House Rooftop
music.why: A marquee progressive-house return set on a downtown rooftop at golden hour
music.summary: EMBRZ returns to headline the Harbor House Rooftop in downtown LA, with support from Nick Newman and Dreamteller, presented by All Day All Night and Safra.

music.name: KATAMARAVE: 2 Mello, Ava Blank, Starpiercer, djX
music.why: Playful ball-pit rave with hot dogs and tacos, not just another warehouse night
music.summary: Constantkilljoy presents Katamarave, a late-night tech house, speed garage, hip-hop and drum-and-bass party at The Compound by Dirt Dog with a ball pit and food from Dirt Dog.

music.name: MUSEO 002: Shay De Castro
music.why: Curated techno series leaning into a nature-meets-machine soundscape
music.summary: Shay De Castro's MUSEO series returns for its second installment at Que Sera in Long Beach, with Chris Miranda supporting on dub techno and techno.

music.name: NIGHTSHIFT AFTER HOURS
music.why: A real DTLA speakeasy after-hours for dancers who need somewhere after 2am
music.summary: Blind Tiger's Nightshift is a weekly after-hours underground house night at DTLA speakeasy The Lexington, entered through the alley, with a secret rotating DJ lineup.

music.name: Beyond The Decks Takeover: Glass Halo, CEEDs, Nash Rly
music.why: Free daytime beachfront set right on the Venice boardwalk
music.summary: A free daytime house and EDM takeover at The Waterfront Venice on the Venice boardwalk, featuring Glass Halo, CEEDs and Nash Rly.

music.name: INQUISITIVE
music.why: Asian pop/anime-anthem EDM debut in LA, a genre lane few LA club nights cover
music.summary: Acclaimed Asian electronic producer Inquisitive makes his LA debut at Avalon Hollywood, transforming Mandarin, Cantonese, K-pop, J-pop and Asian pop classics into festival anthems, with support from FEVER and Ronni Soul.

music.name: Carlita
music.address: 451 Gin Ling Way, Los Angeles, CA 90012
music.why: Open-air neon Chinatown plaza setting for a house set, part of a summer series
music.summary: Carlita headlines an open-air house set at Gin Ling Way in Chinatown's Central Plaza, part of the venue's summer series, with Minus the Light and KinAhau.

music.name: 90's House and Rave Classics (Leo's B-Day Bash)
music.why: A throwback 90's house and rave set instead of the usual current-genre club night
music.summary: DJ Sol La hosts a 90's house and rave classics night at High Tide in the Arts District, doubling as Leo's birthday bash.

music.name: LNY TNZ
music.why: One of the few hardstyle-specific bookings on the LA/OC calendar this weekend
music.summary: Trinity presents Dutch hardstyle DJ LNY TNZ at The Circle OC in Huntington Beach.

music.name: Drezo X One True God
music.why: Big-room tech house/midtempo bass double bill in the heart of Hollywood
music.summary: Drezo and One True God co-headline a tech house, big room house and midtempo bass night at Academy Nightclub in Hollywood.

music.name: Nurko X Jvna
music.address: 618 S Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90014
music.why: Melodic dubstep/future bass co-headline in a historic Art Deco former stock exchange
music.summary: Nurko and Jvna co-headline a future bass, trap and melodic dubstep night at Exchange LA, the multi-level club housed in the former Pacific Stock Exchange building.

music.name: Early Birdz - Flight 012 / LA Penthouse Rave
music.why: Sober daytime rave with zero-proof cocktails, IV therapy and a full wellness bazaar
music.summary: Flight 012 lands at Pluto Penthouse for a five-hour sober-curious Sunday party with house DJs, an alcohol-free bar, brunch bites, wellness pop-ups and family-friendly all-ages entry.

music.name: Tech Me 2 Da Beach 9 Year Anniversary White Party: JJ Flores, Big Cee, Discopennylane, IM:ME, Holliday, Darin Westcott
music.address: 4800 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
music.why: Free beachfront white-party throwdown with dogs welcome on the sand
music.summary: Tech Me 2 Da Beach marks its 9th anniversary with a free white-party dance session on Rosie's Dog Beach, headlined by JJ Flores and a house/disco DJ lineup.

music.name: Lee Foss (Cielo du Sol in Malibu)
music.why: Hot Creations co-founder headlines an all-day vineyard day party in the Santa Monica Mountains
music.summary: Lee Foss, co-founder of Hot Creations and Hot Natured, headlines a daylong deep house and tech house session at Cielo Farms, a vineyard event space in the Malibu hills.

music.name: Azure Huntington Beach w/ No Static
music.address: 21058 Pacific Coast Highway, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
music.why: Oceanfront day party in the Pacific City complex, a beach-club staple for the SoCal day-party crowd
music.summary: Azure's recurring Huntington Beach day party returns to The Bungalow's oceanfront deck with No Static on the decks for a house-focused afternoon-into-evening set.

music.name: Bears In Space Lot Party with Warehouse Preservation Society
music.why: Long-running queer bear day-into-night parking-lot party, always free for trans community members
music.summary: Bears In Space's penultimate lot party of the season hands the decks to Warehouse Preservation Society for an acidic house set, plus pop-ups from LAG Vintage, Horse & Horn and Rosie's Tacos.

music.name: Fog Ephemeral: Megafang, Inle, Jelly Bebe, Solitaire
music.address: 3027 S. Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90007
music.why: Live installation and video art paired with an experimental-techno performance lineup
music.summary: Fog Ephemeral is Megafang's inaugural group performance and exhibition night at Water & Power, combining an art installation and video projection with live experimental/techno sets.

music.name: Sunday Sessions LA (Vinyl Only) Open Air
music.address: 450 S Bixel St, Los Angeles, CA 90017
music.why: Vinyl-only open-air set free before 7pm, a rare all-analog spin in a downtown studio lot
music.summary: Sunday Sessions LA's recurring vinyl-only open-air party takes over the Los Angeles Center Studios lot for an evening of house, deep house and minimal, free before 7pm.

music.name: Nightshift After Hours
music.why: Alley-entrance DTLA speakeasy that stays open after hours seven nights a week
music.summary: Nightshift's recurring after-hours speakeasy night at The Lexington runs underground house music into the early morning, with free RSVP entry before 1am.

sports.name: LA Running Club — Wednesday Night Track
sports.why: Structured threshold-track training, not just a social jog, capped at 50 runners
sports.summary: LA Running Club's weekly Wednesday Night Track is a threshold track-training session on the Santa Monica High School track, limited to 50 runners on a first-come basis.

sports.name: Venice Run Club — Mobbin Wednesday
sports.why: One of the largest weekly run-club meetups anywhere — over a thousand runners most weeks
sports.summary: Venice Run Club's free Wednesday run is a 4.5-mile group run starting from the Dell Avenue parking lot, drawing over a thousand runners most weeks with no sign-up required.

sports.name: Koreatown Run Club — Thursday at Love Hour
sports.address: 532 N Western Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90004
sports.why: A no-sign-up social run with a built-in after-party — burgers and drinks at Love Hour
sports.summary: Koreatown Run Club's weekly Thursday run meets at Love Hour for a 3 or 5 mile social run, no sign-up required, followed by burgers and drinks at the bar.

sports.name: Nightowls Bicycle Club — Thursday Therapy
sports.address: 1111 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015
sports.why: A casual no-drop weekly ride for anyone, not just fast training groups
sports.summary: Nightowls Bicycle Club's weekly Thursday Therapy is a casual, no-drop community ride starting at Crypto.com Arena in downtown LA.

sports.name: Thursday Night Skate (Culver City)
sports.why: An all-wheels-welcome group roll, not roller-skaters only — skaters and cyclists join too
sports.summary: Skate Hunnies' weekly Thursday Night Skate is a community meetup for roller skaters and rollerbladers in Culver City, open to all wheels including skateboarders and cyclists, rolling out around the neighborhood.

sports.name: LA Friday Night Skate
sports.why: A weekly 10-15 mile skate roll through Santa Monica for intermediate-plus skaters
sports.summary: LA Friday Night Skate meets at Santa Monica City Hall every Friday at 9pm for a group skate of roughly 10-15 miles through the city.

sports.name: LA Leggers Saturday Group Run
sports.why: Marathon-training pace groups for every level, right on the pier at sunrise
sports.summary: LA Leggers hosts its standing Saturday morning group run from the Santa Monica Pier, with pace groups from walkers to marathon veterans and mentors on hand for newcomers.

sports.name: LA Running Club Saturday Track Workout
sports.why: Coach-led marathon-prep track session, a structured alternative to a casual jog
sports.summary: Los Angeles Running Club holds a coach-led Saturday morning training run/track workout at the Santa Monica Totem Pole for runners prepping fall marathons.

sports.name: LA Frontrunners Saturday Run/Walk
sports.address: Crystal Springs Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90027
sports.why: LGBTQ+ running club's standing Griffith Park meetup, an inclusive alternative to the beach runs
sports.summary: LA Frontrunners hosts its weekly Saturday morning run/walk in Griffith Park, meeting at the flag pole by the Jimmy Stewart Memorial with out-and-back routes for all levels.

sports.name: DTLA Running - Sunday Group Run
sports.why: Free downtown run club with 2, 4 and 6-mile pace options for any level
sports.summary: DTLA Running's standing Sunday session meets at The Bloc in downtown LA with runners choosing a 2, 4 or 6-mile route, free and open to all paces since 2008.

sports.name: Los Feliz Running Club - Sunday Run
sports.address: 2650 N Vermont Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90027
sports.why: Free 3-5 mile Griffith Park-adjacent run with real elevation, ends at a neighborhood cafe
sports.summary: Los Feliz Running Club's weekly Sunday session meets at Franklin's Cafe for a free 3-5 mile run through the Los Feliz/Griffith Park area, open to all fitness levels.

sports.name: Los Angeles Wheelmen - Sunday Group Ride
sports.address: El Dorado Park, Studebaker Rd, Long Beach, CA
sports.why: Since-1945 cycling club offers three route lengths (31/45/64 miles) from the same start
sports.summary: LA Wheelmen's Sunday ride meets at El Dorado Park in Long Beach with a choice of 31, 45 or 64-mile routes and varying elevation, free and open to riders of any pace.

sports.name: SoCal Cruisers - Neptune's Net Lunch Ride
sports.why: Classic PCH biker lunch stop with a group ride onward to Venice Beach
sports.summary: SoCal Cruisers' recurring Sunday motorcycle meetup gathers at Neptune's Net on PCH for lunch before riding together to the Venice Beach boardwalk.

sports.name: Los Anarchists Open Skate Session
sports.why: First session free, loaner gear included - the easiest entry point into LA's roller derby scene
sports.summary: Los Anarchists junior roller derby team hosts an open skate session at LA Kings Burbank Sports Center, teaching skating and derby basics with loaner gear available and reservations required.
